testCase.name: [local] S21 Never left waiting with nothing, both contexts: a busy state at once, then the failure message; time to the message and the 20 s attempt cap recorded

descriptionHtml:
Decision D8 · P2 · Daniela

Should In Today reset at server midnight; the worst-case AI wait is ~38 s (UAT says ~30 s); measured 2026-10-15 with both models hanging: Ask AI gives up at 30.0 s, but the pre-round summary only at 62.5 s (its sub-calls go through the 30 s retry sequence twice), past the case's 60 s limit (EFS/S21)

Note: Measured 2026-10-16 on 25acd727 (OAT-03/S09, S11): Generate with both models hanging gives up at 30.0 s (1.0 s when both return 429); Ask AI with Haiku hanging is answered by Mistral at 20.0 s.

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-09/S13, TC-14/S21

Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S21 Never left waiting with nothing, both contexts: a busy state at once, then the failure message; time to the message and the 20 s attempt cap recorded

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • T1 Every AI call (summary, note, billing, Ask AI, photo reading, voice transcription, handoff) retries automatically before showing an error; text calls go Haiku twice, then Mistral; … (TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-92568 AC 5; UAT 3.5)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Standard fixture; the harness makes the model hang past its attempt timeout for Ask AI and for the pre-round summary (both models)

When In Hospital and in Nursing Home: ask an Ask AI question, and press Save Note on a typed pre-round, with both models hanging; snapshot right after each tap and when the screen settles. Then, in Nursing Home, Generate a long note with Haiku failing at once and Mistral answering at 19 s (run c) and at 21 s (run d)

Then Right after each tap the step's busy label is visible; the screen ends on an explicit failure message with a next step, never a spinner still running after 60 s. The tap-to-message time and the AI call's own time (providerMs vs durationMs) are recorded; anything over 30 s is flagged for review with Vikram (3.5), not judged. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Pass/Fail only on 'never left with nothing': each busy checkpoint mustContain the step's own loading label ('Searching' for Ask AI, 'Saving & Updating' for Save Note; a placeholder or a disabled button no longer counts), each settled checkpoint mustNotContain it and has a failure word and a next-step phrase (separate groups). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows; to be decided by Daniela.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S21

Never left waiting with nothing, both contexts: a busy state at once, then the failure message; time to the message and the 20 s attempt cap recorded

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

Both contexts; specs newspec-c/flt-efs-s21-busy.spec.ts, flt-efs-s21-cd.spec.ts, flt-efs-s21-save-timing.spec.ts. Server timing measured first, in-process and with no model: the real askChart / parsePreRoundNotes / generateNote handlers run with a fake ctx whose bedrock.invoke stand-in hangs until each attempt's own timeout, as the SDK abort does (the method of newspec-b TC-10/S27). The 20 s cap (recorded): the first attempt is capped at 20 s and the fallback gets the rest of the 30 s budget (about 10 s, or 20 s when Haiku failed fast). Both models hanging: Ask AI gives up after 30.0 s; the pre-round summary after 62.5 s (its four sub-calls go through the 30 s sequence twice). Those times were then replayed in the browser at the socket. Judged 32/34. Pass: Ask AI shows 'Searching…' at once and, 30.5 s after the tap, 'The chart assistant couldn’t be reached… tap Ask AI again' with the question kept and no spinner (Hospital and Nursing Home); Save Note shows 'Saving & Updating…' at once and ends on 'Note saved, but the structured summary couldn’t be updated. Review the text and tap Save Note to retry.' with the typed text kept. Fail (both contexts): 60 s after tapping Save Note the button still reads 'Saving & Updating…'; the failure arrives 62.8 s after the tap, past the then's 'never a spinner still running after 60 s'. The 62.5 s figure is the one TC-10/S27 (d) recorded and the 2026-10-15 review attached to D8 (worst-case AI wait); times over 30 s are a flag for Vikram (3.5), not judged. Superseded: the Save Note half of efs-s21-h / efs-s21-n held the call 30 s (an assumed server time, settled at 30.4 s); the measured 62.5 s runs (efs-s21-save-h / -n) carry the verdict. Runs c and d (Q16, recorded only; Nursing Home, SNF admission template, a 640-word typed encounter): Haiku throttled twice in the first second; c: Mistral answered at 19 s inside its 20 s cap, the server returned the note after 20.0 s and Post-Round showed it (Copy to EMR) 20.4 s after the tap; d: Mistral's 21 s answer was cut off by its 20 s cap, the server failed after 21.0 s and the Encounter tab showed 'The visit dictation is saved, but the note couldn’t be generated…' 21.4 s after the tap, no note stored ('Note not generated' wording: D7). aiCallLog rows from the in-process runs (durationMs / providerMs): askChart 30006 / 30003 ms, parsePreRoundNotes 62518 / 60012 ms (error class rate_limited).

Product issue: When both AI models are unresponsive, a physician who taps Save Note on the pre-round watches 'Saving & Updating…' for about 63 s before the failure message (Ask AI fails at 30 s); the case allows no spinner past 60 s.

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 25 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: fault-ai, action-timing, variants. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
